AI Short Film Studio 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides an end-to-end, low-cost workflow for AI-generated short films/episodes using the Sucang API for video and TTS, with FFmpeg+Python local composition, and WorkBuddy for orchestration.
- Supports full pipeline: scriptwriting, video generation, multi-role TTS, audio-driven video editing, subtitle overlay, final rendering, asset export, and cost calculation.
- Designed for users needing rapid AI short-form content creation (short films, drama episodes, trailers, etc.) from scratch, at a reference cost of ¥30–50 per film (about 128 seconds).
- Includes detailed best practices, troubleshooting notes, and real project case studies.
- Documented with step-by-step instructions, cost breakdowns, platform API details, and iterative review guidance.
